attchmntText: Landmark Property Development Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Landmark Property Development Company Limited submitted its unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on November 13, 2026. The company reported a profit of 17.90 lacs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 3.27 lacs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the profit was 696.43 lacs versus a loss of 3.95 lacs previously. Revenue from operations stood at 123.19 lacs for the quarter. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the results. An emphasis of matter highlights the recoverability of space booking advances from Eterna Living Pvt. Ltd., with a gross outstanding balance of 2,711.15 lacs and a net carrying amount of 1,111.15 lacs after a provision of 1,600.00 lacs. The company also recognized a reversal of expected credit loss provisions totaling 776.83 lacs during the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
